author: KEXP
description: Los-Angeles trio Faetooth conjure up a mystifying mix of doom metal, sludge, and shoegaze. With spellbinding melodies and cathartic arrangements, the band join host Tanner Ellison Live on KEXP with a performance of "Death Of Day" and more.
title: Faetooth performs "Death Of Day" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:

Ari May - Vocal, Guitar
